package task

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

// TaskDetails aggregates task payload with related entities required by HTTP adapters.
type TaskDetails struct {
	Task                  *domain.Task
	Tests                 []domain.TaskTest
	StarterFiles          []domain.TaskFileStorage
	LearningTargets       []domain.TaskLearningTarget
	CodeStructureTypeCode *string
}

// GetTaskDetails loads one task with related tests/files and optional internal metadata.
type GetTaskDetails struct {
	Tasks           repository.TaskRepository
	TaskTests       repository.TaskTestRepository
	TaskFiles       repository.TaskFileStorageRepository
	LearningTargets repository.TaskLearningTargetRepository
	Structures      repository.CodeStructureTypeRepository
}

// Handle returns task aggregate for API serialization.
func (uc GetTaskDetails) Handle(ctx context.Context, taskID string, includeInternal bool) (*TaskDetails, error) {
	taskEntity, err := uc.Tasks.Get(ctx, taskID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	var tests []domain.TaskTest
	if uc.TaskTests != nil {
		tests, err = uc.TaskTests.ListByTask(ctx, taskID)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}

	var starterFiles []domain.TaskFileStorage
	if uc.TaskFiles != nil {
		starterFiles, err = uc.TaskFiles.ListByTask(ctx, taskID)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}

	var learningTargets []domain.TaskLearningTarget
	if uc.LearningTargets != nil {
		learningTargets, err = uc.LearningTargets.ListByTask(ctx, taskID)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		taskEntity.LearningTargets = learningTargets
	}

	var codeStructureTypeCode *string
	if includeInternal && uc.Structures != nil {
		structureType, err := uc.Structures.GetByID(ctx, taskEntity.CodeStructureTypeID)
		if err != nil && err != domain.ErrNotFound {
			return nil, err
		}
		if structureType != nil {
			code := structureType.Code
			codeStructureTypeCode = &code
		}
	}

	return &TaskDetails{
		Task:                  taskEntity,
		Tests:                 tests,
		StarterFiles:          starterFiles,
		LearningTargets:       learningTargets,
		CodeStructureTypeCode: codeStructureTypeCode,
	}, nil
}
